title: Record page: the Details / Related / Activity / History tabs, the header's quick actions and the app pill have accessible names
body:
## Source

Read from the accessibility tree on objectui main `8415d9f11`, the lead record page: the four tabs read as `tab` with no name; the three header quick-action buttons (Log a Call, Log a Meeting, Schedule a Meeting) read as `button` with no name while their text is visible; the app bar's app pill (HotCRM ▾) reads as `button` with no name; the section header buttons in Details read unnamed. Same shape as objectui#12510, which fixed it in Studio. Verify with the same tool first: a name computed from visible text may read empty where the text is in an `aria-hidden` span.

## Target

1. Each tab's accessible name is its label; each action button's name is its label; the app pill's name is "Switch app · HotCRM"; section headers are buttons named by the section title.
2. No `aria-hidden` on the only text of a control.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: `getByRole('tab', { name: 'Related' })`, `getByRole('button', { name: 'Log a Call' })`, `getByRole('button', { name: /HotCRM/ })` resolve.
2. The accessibility tree of the lead record, pasted in the PR, shows no unnamed tab or button.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test` green.

## Evidence

No screenshot; the measurements above are the evidence.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
